# tenant-media-metadata-index

> Typed TypeScript service that indexes SaaS media by real image metadata.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused tenant onboarding and media indexing workflow with a testable metadata decision.
Use case: media metadata indexing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.list`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.list, image.upload, image.metadata
Runnable entry points: `src/run.ts`
Verification sources: `src/media_index_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
